articles.title: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen
articles.snippet: Attackers raced to convert stolen stablecoins into crypto that issuers could not freeze as industry players like Tether and Circle moved to immobilize billions of dollars in assets.

articles.title: Tether’s excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer’s US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion at the end of September.

articles.title: Binance Hacker Hunts for Exit Ramps as DeFi Exchanges Pause Markets
articles.snippet: Etherscan records show wallets tied to the suspected Binance hack swapping freezable stablecoins for Ethereum on decentralized exchanges.

articles.title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
articles.snippet: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.
